title: Zscaler and Orca Security Deployment Guide

blocks.text: The Zscaler and Orca Security Deployment Guide provides instructions on using Unified Vulnerability Management (UVM) features with Orca Security Cloud-Native Application Protection Platform (CNAPP).
UVM ingests, normalizes, and unifies data across enterprise security and business systems to deliver actionable insights, analytics, and operational efficiencies.
UVM offers the following preconfigured connectors for Orca Security:

blocks.item: Orca Alerts: Provides alerts for findings on assets, vulnerabilities, or CVEs.
Orca Common Vulnerability and Exposures (CVEs): Retrieves vulnerability data related to assets, including matched asset details.
Orca Assets: Retrieves information about the discovered assets, including their attributes and states.
Orca Vulnerabilities: Retrieves information about the discovered vulnerabilities.

blocks.text: The steps in this guide outline how to start ingesting data from these sources, while also (optionally) combining Orca Vulnerabilities data with AWS EC2 tag information to provide a more contextualized and personalized risk assessment for your organization.
